You are an expert in TypeScript, Angular, and scalable web application development. You write functional, maintainable, performant, and accessible code following Angular and TypeScript best practices.

## TypeScript Best Practices

- Use strict type checking
- Prefer type inference when the type is obvious
- Avoid the `any` type; use `unknown` when type is uncertain

## Angular Best Practices

- Always use angular schematics for new files (ng generate ...) unless there is no generator
  - Do not change options - schematic will use angular.json defaults
  - For pages use `ng g c ... --type=page`
  - For models use `ng g interface ...`
  - For data sources and services use `ng g s ...`

- Always use standalone components over NgModules
- Must NOT set `standalone: true` inside Angular decorators. It's the default in Angular v20+.
- Do NOT set `changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush` explicitly. `OnPush` is the default in Angular v22+.
- Use signals for state management
- Implement lazy loading for feature routes
- Do NOT use the `@HostBinding` and `@HostListener` decorators. Put host bindings inside the `host` object of the `@Component` or `@Directive` decorator instead
- Use `NgOptimizedImage` for all static images.
  - `NgOptimizedImage` does not work for inline base64 images.

## Accessibility Requirements

- It MUST pass all AXE checks.
- It MUST follow all WCAG AA minimums, including focus management, color contrast, and ARIA attributes.

## Components

- Keep components small and focused on a single responsibility
- Use `input()` and `output()` functions instead of decorators
- Use `model()` for two-way bound properties with `[(prop)]` syntax instead of pairing `input()` with `output()`
- Use `computed()` for derived state
- Use `linkedSignal()` for state derived from multiple reactive sources that must stay synchronized
- Prefer inline templates for small components
- Prefer Signal Forms (`@angular/forms/signals`) for new forms. They are stable in Angul

import { Component, input } from '@angular/core';

/**
 * Label/value pair. The `label` input or a `[info-label]` element renders the label; the `value` input or projected content renders the value.
 *
 * @example
 * ```html
 * <app-info-item label="Value" value="$48,000" />
 * ```
 *
 * @example
 * ```html
 * <app-info-item value="Anna Kowalska">
 *   <span info-label>Contact</span>
 * </app-info-item>
 * ```
 *
 * @example
 * ```html
 * <app-info-item label="Public">{{ deal.public ? 'Yes' : 'No' }}</app-info-item>
 * ```
 *
 * @example
 * ```html
 * <app-info-grid>
 *   <app-info-item label="Value" value="$48,000" />
 *   <app-info-item label="Contact" value="Anna Kowalska" />
 * </app-info-grid>
 * ```
 *
 * @snippet [info-item](.vscode/shared-components.code-snippets#L13)
 * @snippet [info-item-label](.vscode/shared-components.code-snippets#L21)
 * @snippet [info-item-value](.vscode/shared-components.code-snippets#L31)
 *
 * @owner Mateusz Kulesza <mateusz@sages.oi>
 * @see [InfoGrid](./info-grid.ts)
 */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-info-item',
  host: { class: 'grid  ' },
  template: `
    <div class="text-label-lg text-on-surface">
      <ng-content select="[info-label]">{{ label() }}</ng-content>
    </div>
    <div class="mt-1 text-body-lg text-on-surface">
      <ng-content>{{ value() }}</ng-content>
    </div>
  `,
})
export class InfoItem {
  label = input<string | null>();
  value = input<string | null>();
}
````

      display: block;
    }

        <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h2 class="text-title-md text-on-surface">

          <app-info-item label="Value" [value]="deal.value | currency" />
          <app-info-item label="Contact" value="Anna Kowalska" />
          <app-info-item label="Public">{{ deal.public ? 'Yes' : 'No' }}</app-info-item>
        </app-info-grid>

## Plan: Reusable `ui-card` shared component

Build a `ui-card` in `shared/ui/card/` with optional sub-components for explicit composition. Layout is inferred from inputs and projected content. Each default slot ships with a default sub-component that forwards nested content, similar to `src/app/core/layouts/app-shell/app-shell.ts`.  is migrated as the first consumer, since its current layout (title, stage badge + Edit button, description, info grid) maps directly onto variant 3.

**Steps**

1. **Create the card primitives** in `src/app/shared/ui/card/`: `ui-card` (root, , `subtitle` inputs, plus `ng-content` slots `[ui-card-header]`, `[ui-card-body]`, default content), `ui-card-header`, `ui-card-title`, `ui-card-subtitle`, `ui-card-actions`, `ui-card-badge`, `ui-card-body`. Sub-components are standalone and reused by the root's default markup.
2. **Default-slot behavior** *depends on 1*: if no `[ui-card-header]` is projected, `ui-card` renders a default `ui-card-header` built from its /`subtitle` inputs. `[ui-card-actions]` and `[ui-card-badge]` projected on `ui-card` are forwarded into that default header. If no title, subtitle, actions, or badge exist, the header is not rendered (simple variant, body only).
3. **Nested slots** *depends on 1*: `ui-card-header` exposes its own `ng-content select="[ui-card-actions]"` and `[ui-card-badge]` slots, so `<ui-card><ui-card-header><div ui-card-actions/></ui-card-header></ui-card>` works. Header slots are passed through, not duplicated.
4. **Body and free content**: `[ui-card-body]` is optional. Unmatched content on `ui-card` falls into a default body slot, so `<ui-card><p>text</p></ui-card>` gives the simple variant.
5. **Export**: add `UiCard` (and sub-components) to shared/index.ts and to the  array.
6. **Migrate ** *depends on 1–5*: replace the `<article>` markup in `src/app/features/deals/ui/deal-details-card/deal-details-card.ts` with `ui-card` (title = deal title, subtitle = description, actions = Edit button, badge = `app-deal-stage-badge`, body = `app-info-grid`). Keep the  output.
7. **Snippet and JSDoc** *parallel with 6*: add `ui-card` prefixes to `.vscode/shared-components.code-snippets` and JSDoc `@example` blocks on each component, following the `@snippet`/`@owner`/`@see` convention in `src/app/shared/ui/info-grid/info-item.ts`.

**Relevant files**

- `src/app/shared/ui/card/card.ts` (new), plus sub-component files in the same folder: root and sub-components. Follows the `info-grid/` folder pattern.
- `src/app/shared/index.ts`: add exports and  entry.
- `src/app/features/deals/ui/deal-details-card/deal-details-card.ts`: migration target. Current classes to keep: `bg-surface-container-lowest p-5 shadow-level1` move into `ui-card` styles.
- `.vscode/shared-components.code-snippets`: new snippets.
- `angular.json`: `prefix` is `app` (line 45). Not changed unless you approve it (see Further Considerations).

**Verification**

1. `ng build` (or `npm start` task) compiles with no template errors. Check the  barrel still resolves.
2. Manual check on the deals page: DealDetailsCard looks the same as before (title, stage badge, Edit button, description, info grid). Edit still emits.
3. Render the three variants in a temporary page or the deals page: body only, title + subtitle + body, and title + actions/badge + subtitle + body. Confirm the header is absent when there is no title/subtitle/actions/badge.
4. Verify both nesting forms: `<ui-card title="x"><div ui-card-actions/></ui-card>` and `<ui-card><ui-card-header><div ui-card-actions/></ui-card-header></ui-card>` render the actions in the header.
5. Accessibility: AXE check on the deals page. Title uses a heading element, and the card uses `<article>` or `<section>` consistently.

**Decisions**

- Variant is inferred. No `variant` input.
- Folder is `shared/ui/card/` (domain-independent, per `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`).
- Explicit `ui-card-header` takes precedence over the root /`subtitle` inputs for header content. Projected `ui-card-actions` and `ui-card-badge` are still forwarded when an explicit header is used.
- Scope in: sub-components, nested slots, migration of , snippet, JSDoc.

1. **Prefix conflict**: `angular.json` sets `"prefix": "app"`, so `ng g c` generates `app-` selectors. Options: (A) hand-write `ui-` files and keep the generator default (recommended, no config change). (B) Change the project `prefix` to `ui`, which affects all future components. (C) Keep `app-` and rename the selector. Please confirm A, B, or C.
2. **Heading level**: title renders as `h2` by default. Add a `headingLevel` input (2–6) for correct document outline, or keep `h2` fixed? Recommendation: add the input with default `2`.
3. **Explicit header vs. root inputs**: when both  on `ui-card` and an explicit `ui-card-header` are given, the header wins and root inputs are ignored. Recommendation: keep this rule and document it in the JSDoc.

import { Component, input } from '@angular/core';

export type HeadingLevel = 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6;

/** Default header of `ui-card`, or an explicit header with its own `title`/`subtitle`. */
@Component({
  selector: 'ui-card-header',
  host: { class: 'flex items-start justify-between gap-4' },
  template: `
    <div class="min-w-0">
      @if (title()) {
        <div role="heading" [attr.aria-level]="headingLevel()" class="text-title-md text-on-surface">
          {{ title() }}
        </div>
      }
      @if (subtitle()) {
        <p class="mt-1 text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">{{ subtitle() }}</p>
      }
    </div>
    <div class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-3">
      <ng-content select="[ui-card-badge]" />
      <ng-content select="[ui-card-actions]" />
    </div>
  `,
})
export class UiCardHeader {
  title = input<string>();
  subtitle = input<string>();
  headingLevel = input<HeadingLevel>(2);
}

```

import { Component, computed, contentChild, input } from '@angular/core';
import { UiCardActions } from './card-actions';
import { UiCardBadge } from './card-badge';
import { HeadingLevel, UiCardHeader } from './card-header';

/**
 * Card with optional header and body. Root `title`, `subtitle`, `[ui-card-actions]` and `[ui-card-badge]`
 * build a default header; an explicit `ui-card-header` replaces it and hides root header content.
 *
 * @example
 * ```html
 * <ui-card [title]="deal.title" [subtitle]="deal.description">
 *   <button ui-card-actions type="button">Edit</button>
 *   <app-info-grid>...</app-info-grid>
 * </ui-card>
 * ```
 */
@Component({
  selector: 'ui-card',
  host: { class: 'block' },
  template: `
    <article class="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-md bg-surface-container-lowest p-5 shadow-level1">
      <ng-content select="ui-card-header" />
      @if (showDefaultHeader()) {
        <ui-card-header [title]="title()" [subtitle]="subtitle()" [headingLevel]="headingLevel()">
          <ng-content select="[ui-card-badge]" />
          <ng-content select="[ui-card-actions]" />
        </ui-card-header>
      }
      <div>
        <ng-content />
      </div>
    </article>
  `,
})
export class UiCard {
  title = input<string>();
  subtitle = input<string>();
  headingLevel = input<HeadingLevel>(2);

  private readonly explicitHeader = contentChild(UiCardHeader, { descendants: false });
  private readonly actions = contentChild(UiCardActions, { descendants: false });
  private readonly badge = contentChild(UiCardBadge, { descendants: false });

  protected readonly showDefaultHeader = computed(
    () =>
      !this.explicitHeader() && !!(this.title() || this.subtitle() || this.actions() || this.badge()),
  );
}

````
